text:
Maya: Drafting a 1-pager for private & VPC-first customers. Idea: four panels — value prop, security & compliance snapshot, quickbench highlights, and sales routing + CTA. Figma sketch: https://redwood.app/figma/private-brief-v2

Diego: Good. Add a short engineering note: supported fallback chain (hosted -> dedicated -> private) and model variant fallback for degraded capacity. One line, inline with the ops panel.

Li: Bench owner here. Latest numbers from 2026-03-20 run: text-gen-2 @ 512 tokens p95 = 68ms on Dedicated, median cost per 1k tokens = $0.42. Comparable self-host sample we ran across customers averaged $0.70/k, so roughly ~40% unit cost improvement. I'll upload raw csv.

Sam: Please include a small FAQ bullet on KMS/HSM integrations, audit log retention options, and SOC2/ISO coverage. Sales will ask for specifics during handoff.

Diego: For the webinar demo (Apr 9 proposed), we should show live routing rules and an automated failover during a simulated outage. Sam can moderate the customer questions.

Maya: Agreed. Marketing deliverables: 1) One-pager PDF (print + digital), 2) short social post (30-45s script) + hero image, 3) webinar landing copy + gated download. Draft headline options: "Secure, predictable LLM serving for regulated apps" vs "Enterprise-grade SLAs and private inference". We should A/B test headline on the landing.

Li: Attaching routing pseudo code snippet for the field playbook so they can copy/paste:

```
# inbound routing example
if customer.region == 'EU' and customer.compliance == 'high':
    send_to -> private-vpc-eu
elif committed_monthly >= 10000:
    send_to -> dedicated-reservation
else:
    send_to -> hosted-standard
```

Sam: I'll draft the gated download form fields (company, role, compliance reqs, expected QPS) and a short sales play checklist. Also proposing a post-webinar nurture: 3-email sequence focusing on security, cost, and demo replay.

MarcomBot: Landing page template created: https://redwood.app/landing/private-inference. I can queue announcement for Apr 9 09:00 PT if assets land by Apr 5 EOD.

Maya: Task assignments: Maya = final copy + one-pager layout; Li = benchmark slides + csv; Diego = demo infra + failover script; Sam = field playbook + gated form + nurture emails; MarcomBot = landing + scheduling.

Diego: One more ask: include a short callout on observability — token-level cost breakdown and per-route latency charts. Field teams love that.

Maya: Done. I'll add a tiny dashboard screenshot placeholder in the ops panel. Will post PDF draft here when ready for review. :raised_hands:
